email_subject: Application - Business Development Representative at Alan
email_body:
Dear Alan team,

I'm writing to apply for the Business Development Representative role. Alan's mission to end the wait in healthcare resonates deeply—especially after working on a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor. I'm fluent in English and Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm eager to bring my sales and customer-facing skills to your team.

In my current roles, I've built websites, run SEO campaigns, and managed client relationships. At Episto, I handle client websites, track results with Semrush and Google Analytics, and ensure content is current. My freelance work involves prospecting and converting leads through site-check enquiry flows. I'm highly organised, empathetic, and passionate about understanding prospects' problems—qualities I've honed in client-facing work.

I'm excited about the opportunity to learn the Alan Smart & Soft selling method and contribute to your ambitious growth in Belgium. I'm confident my blend of technical and marketing experience, combined with my drive for sales, makes me a strong fit.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Business Development Representative position at Alan. Alan's mission to end the wait in healthcare and build a new standard in prevention insurance is deeply inspiring. Having worked on a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor, I understand the importance of proactive health solutions and am excited about the opportunity to contribute to Alan's growth in Belgium.

In my current roles as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto and as a freelancer, I have developed strong skills in client communication, lead generation, and relationship management. I have managed client websites, run SEO campaigns, and used tools like Semrush and Google Analytics to track performance. My freelance work has involved building enquiry flows that convert visitors into leads, demonstrating my ability to generate and qualify prospects. I am highly organised, with exceptional follow-up skills, and I thrive on understanding and solving clients' problems—qualities that align perfectly with the BDR role.

I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I am eager to further develop my Dutch in a professional sales environment. I am particularly drawn to Alan's Smart & Soft selling method, which prioritises the prospect experience. I am a team player who enjoys collaborating and challenging the status quo to improve products and strategies.

While my background is in digital marketing, I have always been passionate about sales and customer-facing work. I am confident that my technical and marketing experience, combined with my empathy and drive, will enable me to quickly learn and excel in this role. I am excited about the prospect of joining Alan's dynamic sales team and contributing to your mission of becoming the market leader in Belgium by 2030.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Alan's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
